description: This file contains the implementation of the Voucher API controller within the OpenCart project. It defines a class that handles API endpoints related to vouchers, including methods to add, remove, and apply vouchers, along with their associated request processing and response output.

classes.name: Voucher
classes.description: Controller class for handling voucher-related API requests, including adding, removing, and applying vouchers.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the application of a voucher code via POST request and returns JSON response indicating success or error.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new voucher, validates input, and stores voucher data into session, returning a JSON response.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a voucher from the session based on a provided key, and updates session data accordingly, returning JSON outcome.
